sql: SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN cities ci ON e.city_id = ci.id WHERE e.role = 'sales_rep' AND ci.name = 'Khamis Mushait' ORDER BY e.name

SELECT p.name FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2024-07' AND '2024-09' GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * (oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0) - p.cost)) DESC, p.name LIMIT 3

SELECT e.name FROM employees e JOIN orders o ON o.employee_id = e.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN returns r ON r.order_item_id = oi.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30' GROUP BY e.id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) - SUM(CASE WHEN r.id IS NOT NULL THEN r.refund_amount ELSE 0 END) DESC, e.name LIMIT 3

SELECT e.name FROM orders o JOIN employees e ON o.employee_id = e.id WHERE substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) = '2025' GROUP BY e.id HAVING COUNT(o.id) >= 10 ORDER BY CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(o.id) DESC, e.name LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers cu ON o.customer_id = cu.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND cu.segment = 'retail' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) IN ('2025-01', '2025-02', '2025-03')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT st.customer_id) FROM support_tickets st JOIN (SELECT customer_id, AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS avg_resolution_time FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) AS customer_avg ON st.customer_id = customer_avg.customer_id JOIN (SELECT AVG((julianday(closed_at) - julianday(opened_at)) * 24) AS overall_avg_resolution_time FROM support_tickets WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL) AS overall_avg ON customer_avg.avg_resolution_time > overall_avg.overall_avg_resolution_time JOIN (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) AS customer_orders ON st.customer_id = customer_orders.customer_id GROUP BY st.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT st.id) > 0

WITH H1_2024_Revenue AS (SELECT r.id AS region_id, r.name AS region_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue_h1_2024 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06' GROUP BY r.id, r.name), H1_2025_Revenue AS (SELECT r.id AS region_id, r.name AS region_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100.0)) AS revenue_h1_2025 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN cities ci ON ci.id = c.city_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = ci.region_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND substr(o.order_date, 1, 7) BETWEEN '2025-01' AND '2025-06' GROUP BY r.id, r.name), Combined_Revenue AS (SELECT COALESCE(r24.region_id, r25.region_id) AS region_id, COALESCE(r24.region_name, r25.region_name) AS region_name, COALESCE(r24.revenue_h1_2024, 0) AS revenue_h1_2024, COALESCE(r25.revenue_h1_2025, 0) AS revenue_h1_2025 FROM H1_2024_Revenue r24 FULL OUTER JOIN H1_2025_Revenue r25 ON r24.region_id = r25.region_id), Growth_Rates AS (SELECT region_name, CASE WHEN revenue_h1_2024 = 0 THEN CASE WHEN revenue_h1_2025 > 0 THEN 1000000.0 ELSE 0.0 END ELSE (revenue_h1_2025 - revenue_h1_2024) * 100.0 / revenue_h1_2024 END AS growth_rate FROM Combined_Revenue) SELECT region_name FROM Growth_Rates ORDER BY growth_rate ASC, region_name LIMIT 1
